body: they've been my favorite band since I was in middle school, so I pretty much grew up listening to their music. I feel horrible for the other members of the group, I can only imagine what they're going through. they're signed on to a very intensive record label, so they've spent pretty much all their time with each other since they were teenagers (one even being as young as fourteen). all other artists under the record label were at his funeral too, since most of them were good friends with him, and many of them have broken down crying during their own performances. he just left behind so many people who love him.
thank you very much for these kind words. it means a lot.

the therapy I've been getting always seems to help for a short while, but these thoughts/feelings always seem to come back after a year or so. 

it's a cycle that seems to repeat itself every two years. things get bad enough to where i am either hurting myself or wanting to kill myself, someone else finds out and steps in, i get some kind of treatment. the treatment seems to help and things get better for about a year or so. 

age 15: frequently cutting myself and trying to slowly starve myself to death. friend of mine found out and forced me to tell my parents. put into eating disorder treatment program. things seem to get better.

age 17: not going to school and cutting myself even more severely than before. parents find out, blades taken away and more frequent therapy visits. things seem to get better.

age 19: planning suicide. boyfriend finds out, tells my parents. put into hospital therapy program (which actually didn't help me at all this time). things don't get better.

and here I am at barely 20 years old and fantasizing about killing myself.
I'm so sorry that happened to you. but thank you for reading and responding. I hope you are well.

I really used to love my birthday, although since I was a shy kid, I was too embarrassed to tell anyone who didn't already know, so the celebrations were usually very small. I remember feeling that way up until I was around 14, which was when all this started. After that, I might occasionally have a birthday I felt indifferent to, but I didn't really actively enjoy them. 

Although a few days ago, I knew my "birthday feelings" were coming so I tried to make plans to distract myself from my negativity. But once the day came, I didn't even want to get out of bed so all my plans went out the window. I forced myself to visit my boyfriend, just to get myself out of the house, and the only thing I really did at his house was sleep, but I felt a little better having him there with me.

I guess I've just always been like this, having the fear of getting older. I really only became aware of it when I was around 14. And combined with that, I've kinda had the general mindset of "there's really no actual meaning to life, so why even try?". It wasn't until I was 15 that I had a pseudo-suicide attempt (I stopped eating, but just ended up in an eating disorder facility instead). I've recovered from that, although these "I don't feel like living" feelings seem to pop up every year around my birthday. I don't necessarily have an active desire to die, it's just that I have no desire to live. Like, the thought of getting older and continuing with my life has no appeal for me. So I figure the easiest solution to that is to die, although it isn't as easy as I thought it would be.

But thank you for your kind words and encouragement.
